{{Youmay|the artifact|the [[Kaminoan]] named [[Erla]]}}
The '''Erla Tomvaas''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] artifact found by [[Jacek]]. It appeared to be made out of red glass, but it was actually an unknown substance that created heat. The artifact could be used to create [[Music/Legends|music]]. The Erla Tomvaas was one piece of a larger set known as the [[Siren's Soul]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
